scope: 真实Chrome/Worker/OPFS下载对照，省略逐请求列表；保留计数、hash、故障、GC与单独真实模型结果。
limitations: 耗时为本机诊断，部分测试有重叠；I/O bytes来自storage counters，不是时间推断。
正常流route.continue，不通过route.fetch缓存整个响应；仅损坏/截断故障注入在Node夹具中缓存payload。
peakReadBufferBytes只统计store-owned chunk，不是进程或浏览器RSS。
Chrome请求生命周期事件不替代客户端EOF、完整SHA与OPFS/VFS验证。

chrome-16m.model: not used; no composer submission or ctx.agentLoop execution
chrome-16m.measurements: Actual HTTP request bodies; backend response I/O counters exclude audit downloads and metadata filesystem I/O
chrome-16m.storageIsolation: Each strategy and case owns a new backend dataDir and empty blob store; recovery reuses only its own dataDir and port
chrome-16m.derivedIo: derivedManifestCommitVerifyBytes sums file sizes in successful non-replayed commits because WorkspaceRepository.commit verifies each complete blob; this is source-based accounting, not an observed I/O counter
